statement: On a fixed small complex ball of terminal activities, the cutoff variance correction and the cutoff phase expectation extend to analytic functions of the activity coordinates. If νj = |tj| + |zj| + ∥Rtor j|j ∥, they satisfy d Var(Xnj,s) − v0 nj,s = κnj,stj + O(∥Rtor j|j ∥ + ν2 j ), b Eeiη̄ = pj,szj + O(∥Rtor j|j ∥ + ν2 j ). (3.30) All fixed activity derivatives have the corresponding Taylor bounds, uniformly in entry and stop. The multipliers are positive, bounded above and below, and v0 n,s = ag + O(s/n + n−2 ), κn,s = ag + O(s/n + n−2 ). (3.31) At a common absolute stop, the multipliers pj,s for different entries agree except for their mean- observation-noise factor; their relative difference is O((s1/n)2 + (s2/n)2).
